title: Office of Naval Intelligence man offers Dark Skies creators a deal, which they refuse

plain: In the mid-1990s in Los Angeles, a man from the Office of Naval Intelligence, the Navy's spy service, offered the creators of the UFO television series Dark Skies a deal, and they turned it down, according to Brent Friedman, who created the show with Bryce Zabel and says he was in the room. Friedman tells Michels the man was "so abusive to us in the conference room" and that they realised he would effectively become their boss. He tells it as a sign that naval intelligence tried to steer how Hollywood showed UFOs.
